title: WoRD: Diffusion-Based Posterior Inference for Online Goal Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2611.23192v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Goal recognition is the task of inferring an agent's intended goal from its observed behavior. Most existing work focuses on high-level symbolic recognition, abstracting away the continuous motion through which agents reach their goal. Methods that do reason over continuous trajectories rely on an explicit dynamics model that is hard to acquire and rarely transfers across settings. Neither approach explicitly learns how agents move toward each candidate goal, limiting accuracy on ambiguous trajectory prefixes where such knowledge is most needed.   We present WoRD (Waypoint Recognition with Diffusion), which uses a learned trajectory prior to infer the agent's goal from partial observations. At each step, WoRD runs one warm-started denoising chain per candidate goal, steers each chain toward the observed trajectory through a closed-form log-likelihood gradient, and reweights the resulting samples by Bayes' rule into a calibrated posterior

translated_title: WoRD：基于扩散模型的在线目标识别后验推断
translated_abstract: 目标识别是从智能体的观测行为中推断其意图目标的任务。现有的大多数工作集中在高层符号识别上，将智能体达成目标所经历的连续运动抽象掉；而对连续轨迹进行推理的方法则依赖于显式的动力学模型，该模型难以获取且很少能跨场景迁移。这两种方法都没有显式地学习智能体如何向每个候选目标移动，从而限制了在最需要此类知识的模糊轨迹前缀上的准确性。我们提出了WoRD（Waypoint Recognition with Diffusion，基于扩散的航点识别），它利用学习到的轨迹先验，从部分观测中推断智能体的目标。在每一步中，WoRD为每个候选目标运行一条热启动的去噪链，通过闭式对数似然梯度将每条链引导向观测轨迹，并根据贝叶斯法则对生成的样本进行重新加权，从而得到校准的后验分布。
tldr: 提出了WoRD方法，利用学习到的扩散轨迹先验，为每个候选目标运行热启动去噪链并通过贝叶斯重加权得到校准后验，实现从部分观测中对智能体目标的在线识别。
en_tdlr: WoRD leverages a learned diffusion-based trajectory prior, running warm-started denoising chains per candidate goal with Bayes-rule reweighting to perform online goal recognition from partial observations.
